completion:

## Results need to be described in sufficient detail for an externally independent examiner to replicate your work and arrive at the same conclusion.

### To ensure data captures should include:

- Supplier, model, serial number, age (if this is not self-evident), previous test date.
- Photographic evidence of any faults, good condition etc.
- Attempts to overcome anomalies, such as removing the plug and moving to an alternative outlet.
- Clear indication of residual doubt and select "REJECT" on PLACES software.
